newsitem.title: UK: Baltic Freight Index extends decline, off 7.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Freight Index extends decline, off 7.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was down seven to 1427 points on Friday.
Shipbrokers said they had heard rumoured fixings of Panamaxes at lower levels which, if confirmed, would further expose the nearby weakness in the dry cargo freight market.
They said Oinoussian Lion 73,000 dwt was said fixed to HMM delivery Japan for a trip via Dalrymple Bay with coal to Hong Kong at only $11,000 prompt.
Brokers added that problems stemming grain cargoes from the Mississippi persist with some vessels ballasting away from this area to load in South America.
On the other hand, Halla were said to have fixed the Sinotrans re-let Baumari II for 54,000 heavy grain USG/Japan for end-April/early-May at a broadly unchanged $24.25 no combo.
In this case, however, some doubts were voiced about confirmation of the stem.
